pair_decision.evidence: P1 shows a persistent offset between J1 and J2 in all axes that is removed only by the temporary-offset hypothesis; the permanent-step hypothesis leaves a residual shift after J2, and the isolated-point hypothesis fails to correct the interval. P2 and P3 are invalid because J3 coincides with an independent permanent step (visible as a sustained level change after J3 in original data) and the interval contains a large isolated spike near index 645 that is not part of the J1–J3 offset.
